title: Freya and the House
author: Xanthe Crane
blurb: Ansel Fairweather, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
